why: In every row the circle is once on top, once below and once on the right; the box is once a wide bar, once a tall bar and once a square, and once each black, white and striped. Row 3 needs a white wide bar with the circle below it. In the grid a white box always goes with a striped circle, so the answer is option 2. Option 1 is the same shape but its circle is black.
trick: Split the figure into parts (shape, place, shading) and solve each part on its own.
